description: Java abstract class CobaltService providing an interface for platform service interaction, including lifecycle management, client communication, and native method integration.

classes.name: CobaltService
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for Cobalt platform services, including lifecycle methods, client communication, and native interactions.

classes.name: CobaltService.Factory
classes.description: Interface for creating CobaltService instances and retrieving service names.

classes.name: CobaltService.ResponseToClient
classes.description: Class representing the response from the service to client calls, including validity status and data payload.

methods.name: receiveStarboardBridge
methods.description: Default no-op method to receive a StarboardBridge reference.

methods.name: beforeStartOrResume
methods.description: Abstract method to prepare the service for starting or resuming.

methods.name: beforeSuspend
methods.description: Abstract method to prepare the service for suspension.

methods.name: afterStopped
methods.description: Abstract method to handle cleanup after the service has stopped.

methods.name: receiveFromClient
methods.description: Abstract method to handle data reception from client, returning a ResponseToClient.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the service, marking it as not opened and calling close().

methods.name: close
methods.description: Abstract method to close the service.

methods.name: sendToClient
methods.description: Sends data to the client via native method, synchronized and checks if service is open.
